note: Every strategy with a life history (Project ALPHA 'strategy lifecycle'). Status changes only with a passed test and the owner's yes; the Learner reports live results per entry. Stages (ATLAS multi-stage promotion): a strategy moves one stage only when 'to_pass' is met AND the owner says yes; stage 0 = retired (kept for the record).

strategies.name: VANTAGE trend (Rolling Candle Profile)
strategies.hypothesis: Stocks in a steady rise keep rising; exit on the RCP SELL, 5 ATR stop or 60 days

strategies.name: VANTAGE breakout
strategies.hypothesis: Breaks above recent highs continue; 3 ATR stop, target 3R

strategies.name: VANTAGE dip-buy A/B/C
strategies.hypothesis: Strong stocks bounce after a sharp short fall; exit above the 5-day average

strategies.name: Only stocks trading >= Rs 2 cr/day
strategies.stage_note: round 23: fragile (belief B6 contested); kept for execution safety, live record decides

strategies.name: Buy at 3:20 pm before the close
ADD MORE at day 15 if up 8%+ (1% risk cap)
strategies.evidence: IMPROVE13_RESULTS.md; live_rules_by_year.json (6 of 14 years better, small edge)

strategies.name: No repeat tips across channels
strategies.stage_note: safety rule put live without a history test (belief B7 = assumption); the blocked-repeat record decides

strategies.name: Monthly basket of 20 strongest (cash when NIFTY < 200d)
Third lot at day 30 if up 15%

stages.name: research candidate
stages.to_pass: hypothesis and test plan written (pre-registered) before looking at the holdout

stages.name: historical validation
stages.to_pass: account test: +1 point a year, fall no more than 2 points deeper, both periods and both trade sets

stages.name: independent validation
stages.to_pass: holds year by year, under the stress test (costs, slippage, missed tips) and the luck checks

stages.name: shadow record
stages.to_pass: 30 settled silent live records inside the tested 90% range

stages.name: paper / sent as an idea
stages.to_pass: owner's yes to send it as tips

stages.name: controlled live (1% risk per trade)
stages.to_pass: 100 closed live tips inside the tested range

stages.name: scale or retire
stages.to_pass: review: below range -> retire proposal; inside -> keep; never more than 1% risk
